<!-- file: docs/switch.md -->

# Switch

An on/off switch. **No `label` prop**: wrap it in a `<label>`.

```ts
import { Switch } from 'anvilui'
import type { SwitchProps } from 'anvilui' // = Base UI Switch.Root props
```

## Props (Base UI Switch.Root)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` / `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean, details) => void` | | Not `onChange`. |
| `name`, `value` | `string` | | For forms. |
| `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | |

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { List, ListItem, Switch } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    const [wifi, setWifi] = useState(true)
    return (
        <>
            <label style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <Switch checked={wifi} onCheckedChange={setWifi} />
                Wi-Fi
            </label>

            {/* Settings row: clicking anywhere on the row toggles it */}
            <List>
                <ListItem
                    label="Notifications"
                    description="Push and email"
                    end={<Switch defaultChecked />}
                    render={<label />}
                />
            </List>
        </>
    )
}
```

<!-- file: docs/radio-group.md -->

# RadioGroup, Radio

Pick exactly one option. State lives on the group; each `Radio` has a `value`. **`Radio` has no `label` prop**: wrap it in a `<label>`.

```ts
import { RadioGroup, Radio } from 'anvilui'
import type { RadioGroupProps, RadioProps } from 'anvilui'
```

## RadioGroup props (Base UI RadioGroup)

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `Value` | The picked radio's value. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: Value, details) => void` | |
| `name`, `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly` | | |
| `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` | `string` | Name the group. |

## Radio props (Base UI Radio.Root)

`value: Value` (required), `disabled?: boolean`.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    const [plan, setPlan] = useState('free')
    return (
        <RadioGroup
            aria-label="Plan"
            value={plan}
            onValueChange={setPlan}
            style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 8 }}
        >
            <label style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <Radio value="free" /> Free
            </label>
            <label style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <Radio value="pro" /> Pro
            </label>
        </RadioGroup>
    )
}
```

For a compact row of 2–5 options, [ToggleGroup](toggle-group.md) looks better.

<!-- file: docs/slider.md -->

# Slider

Pick a number, or a range with several handles. Needs `label` or `aria-label`.

```ts
import { Slider } from 'anvilui'
import type { SliderProps } from 'anvilui'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | | Visible label above. Either this or `aria-label`. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | | |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `number` or `number[]` | | An array makes a range with that many handles. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value, details) => void` | | While dragging. Gets the value, not an event: `number` when `value` is a number, `number[]` when it's an array, so a `useState` setter can be passed directly. |
| `onValueCommitted` | `(value, details) => void` | | On release. |
| `min` / `max` / `step` | `number` | `0` / `100` / `1` | |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `true` | Value bubble while dragging or focused. |
| `squiggly` | `boolean` | `false` | Wavy track (horizontal only). |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Vertical is 160px tall; set height via `className`. |
| `format` | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` | | Formats the bubble. |
| `disabled`, `name` | | | |

Base UI docs: `node_modules/@base-ui/react/docs/react/components/slider.md`.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Slider } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    const [volume, setVolume] = useState(40)
    const [price, setPrice] = useState([20, 80])
    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 24, width: 300 }}>
            <Slider label="Volume" value={volume} onValueChange={setVolume} />
            <Slider
                aria-label="Price"
                value={price}
                onValueChange={setPrice}
                min={0}
                max={200}
                format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }}
            />
        </div>
    )
}
```

<!-- file: docs/date-input.md -->

# DateInput

A text field for a date, typed in the user's locale format or picked from a calendar popup. **The value is a `"YYYY-MM-DD"` string, not a `Date`.**

```ts
import { DateInput } from 'anvilui'
import type { DateInputProps } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string \| null` | `null` | `"YYYY-MM-DD"`. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string \| null) => void` | | `null` when cleared. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | | Either this or `aria-label`. |
| `size` | `'small' \| 'normal'` | `'normal'` | |
| `className` | `string` | | On the wrapper. |
| `disabled`, `required`, `id`, `onBlur` | | | On the `<input>`. |

No `min` / `max` / disabled dates.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { DateInput } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    const [start, setStart] = useState<string | null>('2026-11-06')
    return (
        <form>
            <DateInput
                label="Start date"
                value={start}
                onValueChange={setStart}
            />
            {/* `name` on DateInput would submit the locale-formatted text; submit the ISO value like this */}
            <input type="hidden" name="start" value={start ?? ''} />
        </form>
    )
}
```

Convert: `new Date(value + 'T00:00')` for a local `Date`; back with `date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)` (UTC) or format it yourself.

---

<!-- file: docs/time-picker.md -->

# TimePicker

A field that opens a Material 3 time picker (clock dial or typed boxes). **The value is a 24-hour `"HH:mm"` string.**

```ts
import { TimePicker } from 'anvilui'
import type { TimePickerProps } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string \| null` | `null` | `"HH:mm"`, e.g. `"07:30"`, `"19:05"`. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | | On every change. The user can't clear it from the picker; to clear, set `value={null}` yourself (e.g. a Clear button). |
| `type` | `'dial' \| 'input'` | `'dial'` | |
| `hourCycle` | `12 \| 24` | user's locale | 12 shows AM/PM. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | | Either this or `aria-label`. |
| `name` | `string` | | Submits `"HH:mm"` with a form. |
| `size` | `'small' \| 'normal'` | `'normal'` | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange` | | | The popup. |
| `className`, other `<div>` props | | | On the wrapper. |

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { TimePicker } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    const [time, setTime] = useState<string | null>('07:30')
    return (
        <TimePicker
            label="Alarm"
            value={time}
            onValueChange={setTime}
            hourCycle={12}
        />
    )
}
```

# Calendar

A month grid to pick a date. **Values are `"YYYY-MM-DD"` strings.** Locale-aware (first weekday, names).

```ts
import { Calendar } from 'anvilui'

```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string \| null` | `null` | |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | | |
| other | `<div>` props | | |

No range selection, `min` / `max` or disabled dates. For a field with a popup calendar, use [DateInput](date-input.md).

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Calendar } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
```

One box per character, for verification codes and PINs. `length` is required.

```ts
import { PinInput } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string` | | |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string, details) => void` | | |
| `onValueComplete` | `(value: string, details) => void` | | When every box is filled. |
| `validationType` | `'numeric' \| 'alpha' \| 'alphanumeric' \| 'none'` | `'numeric'` | |
| `mask` | `boolean` | `false` | Hide characters. |
| `fillType` | `'filled' \| 'outlined'` | `'outlined'` | |

```tsx
import { PinInput } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
```

<!-- file: docs/dialog.md -->

# Dialog

A modal dialog.

```ts
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogTrigger,
    DialogPopup,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogActions,
    DialogClose,
} from 'anvilui'
import type {
    DialogProps,
    DialogTriggerProps,
    DialogPopupProps,
    DialogTitleProps,
    DialogDescriptionProps,
    DialogActionsProps,
    DialogCloseProps,
} from 'anvilui'
```

## Parts

| Part | Renders | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Dialog` | nothing (state) | `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange(open, details)`, `modal` (default `true`), `disablePointerDismissal`, `morph` |
| `DialogTrigger` | bare `<button>` | `render={<Button />}` to style it. Optional when controlled. |
| `DialogPopup` | portal + backdrop + the dialog box | Put everything else inside. |
| `DialogTitle` | `<h2>` | Required for accessibility. |
| `DialogDescription` | `<p>` | |
| `DialogActions` | `<div>` | The button row at the bottom (the "footer"). |
| `DialogClose` | bare `<button>` | `render={<Button fillType="text" />}`. |

There is **no** `DialogContent`, `DialogOverlay`, `DialogPortal`, `DialogHeader` or `DialogFooter`.

`morph` (boolean, default `false`): the dialog grows out of its trigger, best when the trigger is a surface like a clickable `Card`.

## Example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import {
    Button,
    Dialog,
    DialogActions,
    DialogClose,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogPopup,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
    Input,
} from 'anvilui'

export function DeleteDialog({ onDelete }: { onDelete: () => void }) {
    return (
        <Dialog>
            <DialogTrigger render={<Button color="error" startIcon="delete" />}>
                Delete
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogPopup>
                <DialogTitle>Delete project?</DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>This can't be undone.</DialogDescription>
                <DialogActions>
                    <DialogClose render={<Button fillType="text" />}>
                        Cancel
                    </DialogClose>
                    <DialogClose
                        render={<Button color="error" />}
                        onClick={onDelete}
                    >
                        Delete
                    </DialogClose>
                </DialogActions>
            </DialogPopup>
        </Dialog>
    )
}

// Controlled: open it from anywhere, close it after an async action
export function RenameDialog() {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
    return (
        <>
            <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Rename</Button>
            <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
                <DialogPopup>
                    <DialogTitle>Rename</DialogTitle>
                    <Input label="Name" autoFocus />
                    <DialogActions>
                        <DialogClose render={<Button fillType="text" />}>
                            Cancel
                        </DialogClose>
                        <Button onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Save</Button>
                    </DialogActions>
                </DialogPopup>
            </Dialog>
        </>
    )
}
```

Opening from a `MenuItem`: control the dialog (`open` state) and set it in the item's `onClick`; don't nest the Dialog inside the menu popup. Base UI docs: `node_modules/@base-ui/react/docs/react/components/dialog.md`.

---

<!-- file: docs/bottom-sheet.md -->

# BottomSheet

A panel that slides up from the bottom; swipe down or tap outside to close.

```ts
import {
    BottomSheet,
    BottomSheetTrigger,
    BottomSheetPopup,
    BottomSheetTitle,
    BottomSheetDescription,
    BottomSheetClose,
} from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BottomSheet` | nothing (state) | `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`, `snapPoints` (e.g. `[0.5, 1]`), plus Base UI Drawer.Root props |
| `BottomSheetTrigger` | bare `<button>` | `render={<Button />}` |
| `BottomSheetPopup` | portal + backdrop + sheet + drag handle | Already padded; children scroll. |
| `BottomSheetTitle` | `<h2>` | Names the sheet. |
| `BottomSheetDescription` | `<p>` | |
| `BottomSheetClose` | bare `<button>` | |

```tsx
import {
    BottomSheet,
    BottomSheetPopup,
    BottomSheetTitle,
    BottomSheetTrigger,
    Button,
    List,
    ListItem,
    Icon,
} from 'anvilui'

export function ShareSheet() {
    return (
        <BottomSheet>
            <BottomSheetTrigger render={<Button startIcon="share" />}>
                Share
            </BottomSheetTrigger>
            <BottomSheetPopup>
                <BottomSheetTitle>Share</BottomSheetTitle>
                <List>
                    <ListItem
                        label="Copy link"
                        start={<Icon name="link" />}
                        render={<button type="button" />}
                    />
                    <ListItem
                        label="Email"
                        start={<Icon name="mail" />}
                        render={<button type="button" />}
                    />
                </List>
            </BottomSheetPopup>
        </BottomSheet>
    )
}
```

There is no actions part: for buttons at the bottom use your own row, e.g. `<div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8 }}><BottomSheetClose render={<Button fillType="text" />}>Cancel</BottomSheetClose><Button type="submit">Add</Button></div>`. To close it after a form submit, control it with `open` / `onOpenChange`.

Base UI docs: `node_modules/@base-ui/react/docs/react/components/drawer.md`.

---

<!-- file: docs/popover.md -->

# Popover

A floating panel anchored to its trigger, for content users interact with.

```ts
import {
    Popover,
    PopoverTrigger,
    PopoverPopup,
    PopoverTitle,
    PopoverDescription,
    PopoverClose,
} from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Popover` | nothing (state) | `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`, `modal`, `morph` |
| `PopoverTrigger` | bare `<button>` | `render={<Button />}`; `openOnHover`, `delay` |
| `PopoverPopup` | portal + positioner + panel | `side` (`'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'inline-start' \| 'inline-end'`, default `'bottom'`), `align` (`'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'`), `sideOffset` (4), `alignOffset`, `anchor` |
| `PopoverTitle` | `<h2>` | `render={<h3 />}` to change level |
| `PopoverDescription` | `<p>` | |
| `PopoverClose` | bare `<button>` | `render={<IconButton icon="close" aria-label="Close" />}` |

There is no `PopoverContent`; `side` / `align` go on `PopoverPopup`.

```tsx
import {
    Button,
    IconButton,
    Input,
    Popover,
    PopoverClose,
    PopoverPopup,
    PopoverTitle,
    PopoverTrigger,
} from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <Popover>
            <PopoverTrigger
                render={<Button fillType="outlined" startIcon="filter_list" />}
            >
                Filters
            </PopoverTrigger>
            <PopoverPopup
                side="bottom"
                align="start"
                style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 12, width: 280 }}
            >
                <div
                    style={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                    }}
                >
                    <PopoverTitle>Filters</PopoverTitle>
                    <PopoverClose
                        render={
                            <IconButton
                                icon="close"
                                aria-label="Close"
                                fillType="text"
                                color="container"
                            />
                        }
                    />
                </div>
                <Input label="Min price" type="number" />
            </PopoverPopup>
        </Popover>
    )
}
```

For a hint on hover use [Tooltip](tooltip.md); for a hover preview of a link, [PreviewCard](preview-card.md).

---

<!-- file: docs/preview-card.md -->

# PreviewCard

A card shown while hovering or focusing a link. Hover-only: nothing inside should need clicking (use [Popover](popover.md) for that).

```ts
import { PreviewCard, PreviewCardTrigger, PreviewCardPopup } from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PreviewCard` | nothing (state) | `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange` |
| `PreviewCardTrigger` | `<a>` | `href`, `delay`, `closeDelay`; `render={<Link to="..." />}` for routers |
| `PreviewCardPopup` | portal + positioner + card | `side`, `align`, `sideOffset` (8), `alignOffset` |

```tsx
import {
    Avatar,
    PreviewCard,
    PreviewCardPopup,
    PreviewCardTrigger,
    Typography,
} from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <Typography>
            Written by{' '}
            <PreviewCard>
                <PreviewCardTrigger href="/users/ada">@ada</PreviewCardTrigger>
                <PreviewCardPopup
                    style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center' }}
                >
                    <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" />
                    <span>Ada Lovelace · 12 posts</span>
                </PreviewCardPopup>
            </PreviewCard>
        </Typography>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/tooltip.md -->

# Tooltip

A short hint on hover or keyboard focus. **One component, no parts.** The text is `label`; the single child element is the trigger.

```ts
import { Tooltip } from 'anvilui'
import type { TooltipProps } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | required | The hint text (not `content` or `title`). |
| `children` | `ReactElement` | required | Exactly one element that takes a ref and passes props through (all AnvilUI components do). |
| `side` | `'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'inline-start' \| 'inline-end'` | `'top'` | |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'center'` | |
| `sideOffset`, `alignOffset` | `number` | `4`, `0` | |
| `delay`, `closeDelay` | `number` (ms) | | Hover timing. |
| `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange` | | | |
| `className` | `string` | | On the bubble. |

There is no `TooltipTrigger`, `TooltipContent` or `TooltipProvider` (AnvilRoot provides it).

```tsx
import { IconButton, Tooltip } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <Tooltip label="Delete" side="bottom">
            <IconButton
                icon="delete"
                aria-label="Delete"
                fillType="text"
                color="container"
            />
        </Tooltip>
    )
}
```

- A tooltip is not an accessible name: still give icon buttons `aria-label`.
- On plain text, wrap it in a focusable element: `<Tooltip label="…"><span tabIndex={0}>text</span></Tooltip>`.
- Disabled buttons don't get hover events; wrap them in a `<span>`.

---

<!-- file: docs/menu.md -->

# Menu

A dropdown menu of actions.

```ts
import {
    Menu,
    MenuTrigger,
    MenuPopup,
    MenuItem,
    MenuGroup,
    MenuSubmenu,
    MenuSubmenuTrigger,
} from 'anvilui'
```

## Parts

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Menu` | nothing (state) | `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`, `modal`, `openOnHover` |
| `MenuTrigger` | bare `<button>` | `render={<Button />}` or `render={<IconButton icon="more_vert" aria-label="More" />}` |
| `MenuPopup` | portal + positioner + panel | `side` (default `'bottom'`), `align` (`'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'`), `sideOffset`, `alignOffset` |
| `MenuItem` | menu item | `onClick`, `startIcon`, `endIcon`, `disabled`, `closeOnClick` (default `true`), `render` |
| `MenuGroup` | group | Separates items into blocks (use it instead of a separator). |
| `MenuSubmenu` | nothing (state) | Contains a `MenuSubmenuTrigger` and a `MenuPopup`. |
| `MenuSubmenuTrigger` | item with an arrow | `startIcon`, children |

There is **no** `MenuContent`, `MenuSeparator`, `MenuLabel`, `MenuCheckboxItem` or `DropdownMenu`. Use `onClick` on `MenuItem` (there is no `onSelect`).

## Example

```tsx
import {
    IconButton,
    Menu,
    MenuGroup,
    MenuItem,
    MenuPopup,
    MenuSubmenu,
    MenuSubmenuTrigger,
    MenuTrigger,
} from 'anvilui'

export function FileMenu({ onDelete }: { onDelete: () => void }) {
    return (
        <Menu>
            <MenuTrigger
                render={
                    <IconButton
                        icon="more_vert"
                        aria-label="More actions"
                        fillType="text"
                        color="container"
                    />
                }
            />
            <MenuPopup align="end">
                <MenuGroup>
                    <MenuItem
                        startIcon="edit"
                        onClick={() => console.log('rename')}
                    >
                        Rename
                    </MenuItem>
                    <MenuItem startIcon="content_copy">Duplicate</MenuItem>
                    <MenuSubmenu>
                        <MenuSubmenuTrigger startIcon="drive_file_move">
                            Move to
                        </MenuSubmenuTrigger>
                        <MenuPopup>
                            <MenuItem>Archive</MenuItem>
                            <MenuItem>Trash</MenuItem>
                        </MenuPopup>
                    </MenuSubmenu>
                </MenuGroup>
                <MenuGroup>
                    <MenuItem startIcon="delete" onClick={onDelete}>
                        Delete
                    </MenuItem>
                </MenuGroup>
            </MenuPopup>
        </Menu>
    )
}
```

Links in a menu: `<MenuItem render={<a href="/settings" />}>Settings</MenuItem>`. Right-click menus: [context-menu.md](context-menu.md). A row of menus: [menubar.md](menubar.md). Base UI docs: `node_modules/@base-ui/react/docs/react/components/menu.md`.

---

<!-- file: docs/context-menu.md -->

# ContextMenu

A menu that opens at the pointer on right-click (long-press on touch). Content uses `Menu`'s parts.

```ts
import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuTrigger, MenuPopup, MenuItem } from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ContextMenu` | nothing (state) | `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange` |
| `ContextMenuTrigger` | `<div>` | The area that responds to right-click; `render` to change the element. |
| `MenuPopup`, `MenuItem`, `MenuGroup`, `MenuSubmenu` | | Same as [Menu](menu.md). |

Right-click and long-press only: it can't be opened from the keyboard. Give keyboard users the same actions another way, e.g. a ⋮ [Menu](menu.md) button on each item.

Any content works inside the trigger, including `CardTitle` / `CardContent` when it renders a `Card`.

```tsx
import {
    Card,
    CardContent,
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuTrigger,
    MenuItem,
    MenuPopup,
} from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <ContextMenu>
            <ContextMenuTrigger render={<Card />}>
                <CardContent>Right-click this card</CardContent>
            </ContextMenuTrigger>
            <MenuPopup>
                <MenuItem startIcon="content_copy">Copy</MenuItem>
                <MenuItem startIcon="delete">Delete</MenuItem>
            </MenuPopup>
        </ContextMenu>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/menubar.md -->

# Menubar

A row of menus, like File / Edit / View. Put one `Menu` per entry inside.

```ts
import { Menubar, Menu, MenuTrigger, MenuPopup, MenuItem } from 'anvilui'
import type { MenubarProps } from 'anvilui' // Base UI Menubar props
```

```tsx
import { Menu, Menubar, MenuItem, MenuPopup, MenuTrigger } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <Menubar>
            <Menu>
                <MenuTrigger>File</MenuTrigger>
                <MenuPopup>
                    <MenuItem>New</MenuItem>
                    <MenuItem>Save</MenuItem>
                </MenuPopup>
            </Menu>
            <Menu>
                <MenuTrigger>Edit</MenuTrigger>
                <MenuPopup>
                    <MenuItem>Undo</MenuItem>
                </MenuPopup>
            </Menu>
        </Menubar>
    )
}
```

Inside a Menubar, plain `MenuTrigger`s are styled as menubar entries; don't pass `render={<Button />}`.

---

<!-- file: docs/snackbar.md -->

# useSnackbar

Snackbars (toasts) at the bottom of the screen. **A hook, not a component.** AnvilRoot already renders the viewport: don't add a `<Snackbar>`, `<Toaster>` or provider.

```ts
import { useSnackbar } from 'anvilui'
import type { SnackbarOptions } from 'anvilui'

const snackbar = useSnackbar()
snackbar.show(options: SnackbarOptions): string // returns the id
snackbar.close(id?: string): void               // no id closes all
```

## SnackbarOptions

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `ReactNode` | required | One or two lines. |
| `action` | `{ label: ReactNode; onClick: () => void }` | | One text button, e.g. Undo. Closes the snackbar. |
| `closeButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Show ×. |
| `timeout` | `number` (ms) | `5000` | `0` stays open. |
| `priority` | `'low' \| 'high'` | `'low'` | `high` is announced immediately. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | | |

There is no `type` / `variant` / `severity` (success, error). Put the meaning in the message.

```tsx
import { Button, useSnackbar } from 'anvilui'

export function SaveButton() {
    const snackbar = useSnackbar()
    return (
        <Button
            onClick={() =>
                snackbar.show({
                    message: 'Draft saved',
                    action: {
                        label: 'Undo',
                        onClick: () => console.log('undo'),
                    },
                })
            }
        >
            Save
        </Button>
    )
}
```

Call `useSnackbar()` in a component **inside** `<AnvilRoot>`, not in the component that renders it. Up to 3 stack; a 4th pushes out the oldest.

---

<!-- file: docs/confetti.md -->

# useConfetti

A hook that returns a function firing a burst of confetti in the theme's colors. Does nothing with reduced motion on.

```ts
import { useConfetti } from 'anvilui'
import type { ConfettiOptions, ConfettiOrigin } from 'anvilui'

const fire = useConfetti()
fire(origin?: Element | { x: number; y: number }, options?: ConfettiOptions): void
```

| Option | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number` | `80` |
| `angle` | `number` (degrees, 0 = up) | `0` |
| `spread` | `number` (degrees) | `70` |
| `power` | `number` | `1` |
| `colors` | `ComponentColor[]` | `['primary', 'tonal', 'success', 'warning', 'error']` |

```tsx
import { Button, useConfetti } from 'anvilui'

export function Celebrate() {
    const fire = useConfetti()
    return <Button onClick={(e) => fire(e.currentTarget)}>Celebrate</Button>
}
```

Without an origin it bursts from the bottom middle of the screen. Must be inside `AnvilRoot`.

---

<!-- file: docs/app-bar.md -->

# AppBar

The bar across the top of a screen: title, navigation button, actions. Renders a `<header>`. The title is the **`label` prop**, not children.

```ts
import { AppBar } from 'anvilui'
import type { AppBarProps } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | required | The title. |
| `labelAs` | `'p' \| 'span' \| 'div' \| 'h1' … 'h6'` | `'div'` | Tag for the title; `'h1'` when it's the page heading. |
| `start` | `ReactNode` | | Before the title (menu or back `IconButton`). |
| `end` | `ReactNode` | | After the title (action `IconButton`s, `Avatar`). |
| `size` | `'normal' \| 'big'` | `'normal'` | `big` puts a larger title on its own row. |
| `centered` | `boolean` | `false` | Center the title (normal size only). |
| `color` | `ComponentColor` | `'container'` | Matches navigation surfaces. |
| `fillType` | `'filled' \| 'outlined' \| 'text'` | `'filled'` | `text` makes it the page color. |

Minimum height: 64px (`size="normal"`), 152px (`size="big"`). Not sticky by default: add `style={{ position: 'sticky', top: 0, zIndex: 1 }}`.

```tsx
import { AppBar, Avatar, IconButton } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <AppBar
            label="Inbox"
            labelAs="h1"
            start={
                <IconButton
                    icon="menu"
                    aria-label="Open navigation"
                    fillType="text"
                    color="container"
                />
            }
            end={
                <>
                    <IconButton
                        icon="search"
                        aria-label="Search"
                        fillType="text"
                        color="container"
                    />
                    <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" size="small" />
                </>
            }
        />
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/navigation-bar.md -->

# NavigationBar

Bottom navigation for small screens: 3–5 top-level destinations. You position it (e.g. `position: sticky; bottom: 0`).

```ts
import { NavigationBar, NavigationBarItem } from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NavigationBar` | `<nav>` | Give it `aria-label`. |
| `NavigationBarItem` | `<a>` | `icon: MaterialSymbol` (required), `label: string` (required), `active?: boolean` (sets `aria-current="page"`), `href`, `render` (router link) |

Items are links, not tabs: there's no `value` / `onValueChange`. Mark the current one with `active`.

```tsx
import { NavigationBar, NavigationBarItem } from 'anvilui'

export function Example({ path }: { path: string }) {
    return (
        <NavigationBar
            aria-label="Main"
            style={{ position: 'sticky', bottom: 0 }}
        >
            <NavigationBarItem
                icon="home"
                label="Home"
                href="/"
                active={path === '/'}
            />
            <NavigationBarItem
                icon="search"
                label="Search"
                href="/search"
                active={path === '/search'}
            />
            <NavigationBarItem
                icon="person"
                label="Profile"
                href="/profile"
                active={path === '/profile'}
            />
        </NavigationBar>
    )
}
```

With React Router: `<NavigationBarItem icon="home" label="Home" render={<Link to="/" />} active={...} />`. For client-side state instead of URLs, use `render={<button type="button" onClick={...} />}`.

---

<!-- file: docs/navigation-rail.md -->

# NavigationRail

Side navigation for medium and large screens. Collapsed: icons with small labels; expanded: labels beside icons.

```ts
import {
    NavigationRail,
    NavigationRailToggle,
    NavigationRailItem,
} from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NavigationRail` | `<nav>` (96px wide, `height: 100%`) | `aria-label`; `expanded` / `defaultExpanded` (false) / `onExpandedChange(expanded)` |
| `NavigationRailToggle` | `IconButton` (menu icon) | `aria-label` required. Must be inside the rail. |
| `NavigationRailItem` | `<a>` | `icon` (required), `label: string` (required), `active`, `end` (short badge text, e.g. a count), `href`, `render` |

```tsx
import {
    NavigationRail,
    NavigationRailItem,
    NavigationRailToggle,
} from 'anvilui'

export function Layout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', height: '100vh' }}>
            <NavigationRail aria-label="Main">
                <NavigationRailToggle aria-label="Toggle navigation" />
                <NavigationRailItem
                    icon="inbox"
                    label="Inbox"
                    href="/inbox"
                    active
                    end="12"
                />
                <NavigationRailItem icon="send" label="Sent" href="/sent" />
                <NavigationRailItem
                    icon="settings"
                    label="Settings"
                    href="/settings"
                />
            </NavigationRail>
            <main style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto' }}>{children}</main>
        </div>
    )
}
```

In-page switching without URLs: `render={<button type="button" onClick={() => setView('inbox')} />}` with `active={view === 'inbox'}`. No `nativeButton` needed.

On small screens use [NavigationDrawer](navigation-drawer.md) or [NavigationBar](navigation-bar.md) instead.

---

<!-- file: docs/navigation-list.md -->

# NavigationList

A column of text-only navigation links, like a docs or settings sidebar.

```ts
import { NavigationList, NavigationListItem } from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NavigationList` | `<nav>` | `aria-label` |
| `NavigationListItem` | `<a>` | `label: string` (required; not children), `active`, `href`, `render` |

```tsx
import { NavigationList, NavigationListItem } from 'anvilui'

export function SettingsNav({ section }: { section: string }) {
    return (
        <NavigationList aria-label="Settings">
            <NavigationListItem
                label="Profile"
                href="#profile"
                active={section === 'profile'}
            />
            <NavigationListItem
                label="Notifications"
                href="#notifications"
                active={section === 'notifications'}
            />
            <NavigationListItem
                label="Billing"
                href="#billing"
                active={section === 'billing'}
            />
        </NavigationList>
    )
}
```

For in-page switching without URLs: `render={<button type="button" onClick={() => setSection('billing')} />}`.

<!-- file: docs/navigation-drawer.md -->

# NavigationDrawer

Side navigation that slides in over the page, for small screens.

```ts
import {
    NavigationDrawer,
    NavigationDrawerTrigger,
    NavigationDrawerPopup,
    NavigationDrawerTitle,
    NavigationDrawerItem,
} from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NavigationDrawer` | nothing (state) | `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange` |
| `NavigationDrawerTrigger` | bare `<button>` | `render={<IconButton icon="menu" aria-label="Open navigation" />}` |
| `NavigationDrawerPopup` | portal + backdrop + panel | Put the title first, then items. |
| `NavigationDrawerTitle` | `<h2>` | Names the drawer. |
| `NavigationDrawerItem` | `<a>` that closes the drawer | `icon` (required), `label: string` (required), `active`, `end: ReactNode` (e.g. a count), `href`, `render` |

For in-page switching: `render={<button type="button" onClick={() => setView('trash')} />}`; it still closes the drawer.

```tsx
import {
    AppBar,
    IconButton,
    NavigationDrawer,
    NavigationDrawerItem,
    NavigationDrawerPopup,
    NavigationDrawerTitle,
    NavigationDrawerTrigger,
} from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <AppBar
            label="Mail"
            start={
                <NavigationDrawer>
                    <NavigationDrawerTrigger
                        render={
                            <IconButton
                                icon="menu"
                                aria-label="Open navigation"
                                fillType="text"
                                color="container"
                            />
                        }
                    />
                    <NavigationDrawerPopup>
                        <NavigationDrawerTitle>Mail</NavigationDrawerTitle>
                        <NavigationDrawerItem
                            icon="inbox"
                            label="Inbox"
                            href="/inbox"
                            active
                            end="12"
                        />
                        <NavigationDrawerItem
                            icon="send"
                            label="Sent"
                            href="/sent"
                        />
                    </NavigationDrawerPopup>
                </NavigationDrawer>
            }
        />
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/tabs.md -->

# Tabs

Horizontal tabs with a sliding underline.

```ts
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTab, TabsPanel } from 'anvilui'
import type {
    TabsProps,
    TabsListProps,
    TabsTabProps,
    TabsPanelProps,
} from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Tabs` | `<div>` | `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange(value, details)` |
| `TabsList` | row of tabs | |
| `TabsTab` | `<button>` | `value` (required), `icon?: MaterialSymbol`, `disabled` |
| `TabsPanel` | `<div>` | `value` (matches its tab), `keepMounted` |

There is **no** `TabsTrigger` or `TabsContent`. Horizontal only (no `orientation`).

**Always pass `defaultValue` (or `value`).** Base UI's default is `0`, so with string tab values and no default, no tab is selected.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsPanel, TabsTab } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    const [tab, setTab] = useState<string>('account')
    return (
        <Tabs value={tab} onValueChange={setTab}>
            <TabsList>
                <TabsTab value="account" icon="person">
                    Account
                </TabsTab>
                <TabsTab value="security" icon="lock">
                    Security
                </TabsTab>
            </TabsList>
            <TabsPanel value="account" style={{ padding: 16 }}>
                Account settings
            </TabsPanel>
            <TabsPanel value="security" style={{ padding: 16 }}>
                Security settings
            </TabsPanel>
        </Tabs>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/floating-toolbar.md -->

# FloatingToolbar

A floating pill of icon buttons with arrow-key navigation. You position it.

```ts
import {
    FloatingToolbar,
    FloatingToolbarButton,
    FloatingToolbarSeparator,
} from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Props |
| --- | --- |
| `FloatingToolbar` | `aria-label`; `inverseColor?: boolean` (default `false`); Base UI Toolbar.Root props (`orientation`) |
| `FloatingToolbarButton` | `IconButton` props (`icon`, `aria-label` required). Default `fillType="text"`; `fillType="filled"` makes the highlighted one. |
| `FloatingToolbarSeparator` | |

```tsx
import {
    FloatingToolbar,
    FloatingToolbarButton,
    FloatingToolbarSeparator,
} from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <FloatingToolbar
            aria-label="Formatting"
            style={{
                position: 'fixed',
                bottom: 24,
                left: '50%',
                translate: '-50%',
            }}
        >
            <FloatingToolbarButton icon="format_bold" aria-label="Bold" />
            <FloatingToolbarButton icon="format_italic" aria-label="Italic" />
            <FloatingToolbarSeparator />
            <FloatingToolbarButton
                icon="send"
                aria-label="Send"
                fillType="filled"
            />
        </FloatingToolbar>
    )
}
```

<!-- file: docs/card.md -->

# Card

A rounded surface that groups content. Neutral `container` color by default.

```ts
import { Card, CardTitle, CardContent, CardActions } from 'anvilui'
import type {
    CardProps,
    CardTitleProps,
    CardContentProps,
    CardActionsProps,
} from 'anvilui'
```

## Card props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `ComponentColor` | `'container'` | |
| `fillType` | `'filled' \| 'outlined' \| 'text'` | `'filled'` | |
| `clickable` | `boolean` | `false` | The whole card becomes one button (Base UI Button props: `onClick`, `disabled`, `render`). Buttons and links inside still work on their own. |

A plain card takes `<div>` props.

## Parts

| Part | Renders | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CardTitle` | `<div>` styled as h6 | Pass `as="h2"` (etc.) for a real heading; `type` changes the look. [Typography](typography.md) props. |
| `CardContent` | `<div>` | Padded body. |
| `CardActions` | `<div>` | Button row aligned to the end. |

There is **no** `CardHeader`, `CardFooter`, `CardDescription` or `CardMedia`. Put an `<img>` directly inside the card.

```tsx
import { Button, Card, CardActions, CardContent, CardTitle } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <div
            style={{
                display: 'grid',
                gap: 16,
                gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr))',
            }}
        >
            <Card>
                <CardTitle as="h2">Storage</CardTitle>
                <CardContent>You've used 80% of your space.</CardContent>
                <CardActions>
                    <Button fillType="text">Dismiss</Button>
                    <Button>Upgrade</Button>
                </CardActions>
            </Card>

            <Card
                clickable
                onClick={() => console.log('open')}
                fillType="outlined"
            >
                <CardTitle>Open project</CardTitle>
                <CardContent>Last edited today</CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card clickable render={<a href="/billing" />}>
                <CardTitle>Billing</CardTitle>
            </Card>
        </div>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/list.md -->

# List, ListItem

A column of rows with a label, description and start/end slots. `ListItem` takes **no children**.

```ts
import { List, ListItem } from 'anvilui'
import type { ListProps, ListItemProps } from 'anvilui'
```

## List props

`<ul>` props, plus `divided?: boolean` (lines between items, default `false`).

## ListItem props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | Required. Main text. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | Second line(s). |
| `start` | `ReactNode` | Before: `Icon`, `Avatar`, `Checkbox`. |
| `end` | `ReactNode` | After: `Switch`, `Badge`, text, `Icon`. |
| `render` | `ReactElement` | Make the row interactive: `<a href>`, `<button type="button" />`, `<label />` (toggles a control in start/end), a router `Link`. |

`end` can hold any control, including a `Toggle` (`<Toggle icon="star" aria-label="Favorite" />`) or `IconButton`; don't combine those with a row `render`, since a button inside a button or label is invalid.

Static by default (a `<div>` inside an `<li>`), with no `onClick` behavior of its own: pass `render={<button type="button" />}` for a clickable row.

```tsx
import { Avatar, Checkbox, Icon, List, ListItem, Switch } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <List divided>
            <ListItem
                label="Ada Lovelace"
                description="ada@example.com"
                start={<Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" />}
            />
            <ListItem
                label="Dark theme"
                start={<Icon name="dark_mode" />}
                end={<Switch />}
                render={<label />}
            />
            <ListItem
                label="Remember me"
                start={<Checkbox defaultChecked />}
                render={<label />}
            />
            <ListItem
                label="Account"
                end={<Icon name="chevron_right" />}
                render={<a href="/account" />}
            />
            <ListItem
                label="Sign out"
                start={<Icon name="logout" />}
                render={
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => console.log('bye')} />
                }
            />
        </List>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/table.md -->

# Table

A styled HTML table, `width: 100%` by default. Each part is its native element. No sorting, paging or selection built in. The caption can hold any content, including dynamic text ("3 of 6 users"). There's no visually-hidden helper class: for an actions column, use `<TableHeaderCell><span style={{ position: 'absolute', width: 1, height: 1, overflow: 'hidden', clip: 'rect(0 0 0 0)' }}>Actions</span></TableHeaderCell>`.

```ts
import {
    Table,
    TableCaption,
    TableHead,
    TableBody,
    TableRow,
    TableHeaderCell,
    TableCell,
} from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Element | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Table` | `<table>` | Needs a `TableCaption` or `aria-label`. |
| `TableCaption` | `<caption>` | |
| `TableHead` | `<thead>` | (not `TableHeader`) |
| `TableBody` | `<tbody>` | |
| `TableRow` | `<tr>` | |
| `TableHeaderCell` | `<th scope="col">` | (not `TableHead`); `scope="row"` for row headers |
| `TableCell` | `<td>` | |

```tsx
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCaption,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeaderCell,
    TableRow,
} from 'anvilui'

const invoices = [
    { id: 'INV-1', customer: 'Acme', total: '$1,200' },
    { id: 'INV-2', customer: 'Globex', total: '$860' },
]

export function Example() {
    return (
        <Table>
            <TableCaption>Recent invoices</TableCaption>
            <TableHead>
                <TableRow>
                    <TableHeaderCell>Invoice</TableHeaderCell>
                    <TableHeaderCell>Customer</TableHeaderCell>
                    <TableHeaderCell>Total</TableHeaderCell>
                </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
                {invoices.map((inv) => (
                    <TableRow key={inv.id}>
                        <TableCell>{inv.id}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{inv.customer}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{inv.total}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                ))}
            </TableBody>
        </Table>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/accordion.md -->

# Accordion

Expandable sections.

```ts
import {
    Accordion,
    AccordionItem,
    AccordionTrigger,
    AccordionPanel,
} from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Accordion` | `<div>` | `value` / `defaultValue` (**always an array** of open item values), `onValueChange(value[], details)`, `multiple` (default `false`) |
| `AccordionItem` | `<div>` | `value` (any; auto-generated if omitted), `disabled` |
| `AccordionTrigger` | `<button>` inside a heading | `as`: `'h2' … 'h6'`, default `'h3'` |
| `AccordionPanel` | `<div>` | `keepMounted` |

Without `defaultValue`, every item starts closed. There is no `type="single" \| "multiple"` or `collapsible`: use `multiple`. Items can always be closed.

```tsx
import {
    Accordion,
    AccordionItem,
    AccordionPanel,
    AccordionTrigger,
} from 'anvilui'

export function Faq() {
    return (
        <Accordion defaultValue={['shipping']}>
            <AccordionItem value="shipping">
                <AccordionTrigger>
                    How long does shipping take?
                </AccordionTrigger>
                <AccordionPanel>2–4 business days.</AccordionPanel>
            </AccordionItem>
            <AccordionItem value="returns">
                <AccordionTrigger>Can I return an item?</AccordionTrigger>
                <AccordionPanel>Yes, within 30 days.</AccordionPanel>
            </AccordionItem>
        </Accordion>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/carousel.md -->

# Carousel

A horizontally scrolling row of items, draggable with a mouse. `aria-label` required.

```ts
import { Carousel, CarouselItem } from 'anvilui'
```

| Part | Renders | Props |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Carousel` | `<div role="region">` | `aria-label` (required), `<div>` props |
| `CarouselItem` | `<div>` | `<div>` props. 240px wide by default; set `style={{ width }}`. |

No arrows, dots, autoplay or `index` state.

```tsx
import { Carousel, CarouselItem } from 'anvilui'

const albums = [
    { id: 1, title: 'Blue', cover: '/blue.jpg' },
    { id: 2, title: 'Red', cover: '/red.jpg' },
]

export function Example() {
    return (
        <Carousel aria-label="Featured albums">
            {albums.map((a) => (
                <CarouselItem key={a.id}>
                    <img
                        src={a.cover}
                        alt={a.title}
                        style={{
                            width: '100%',
                            height: 180,
                            objectFit: 'cover',
                        }}
                    />
                </CarouselItem>
            ))}
        </Carousel>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/divider.md -->

# Divider

A thin line between groups of content. Renders a separator `<div>`.

```ts
import { Divider } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Vertical stretches to its flex row's height. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | | Text in the middle ("or"). |
| `squiggly` | `boolean` | `false` | Wavy line. |

```tsx
import { Divider } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <>
            <Divider />
            <Divider label="or" />
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, height: 24 }}>
                <span>Left</span>
                <Divider orientation="vertical" />
                <span>Right</span>
            </div>
        </>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/typography.md -->

# Typography

Text in the theme's type scale.

```ts
import { Typography } from 'anvilui'
import type { TypographyProps, TypographyType, TypographyTag } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'body' \| 'caption' \| 'h1' \| 'h2' \| 'h3' \| 'h4' \| 'h5' \| 'h6'` | `'body'` | The look (not `variant`). |
| `as` | `'p' \| 'span' \| 'div' \| 'h1' … 'h6'` | from `type` | The tag. `body` → `<p>`, `caption` → `<span>`, `hN` → `<hN>`. |

Plus `<p>` props (`id`, `className`, `aria-*`, … all pass through to the rendered tag). No `color`, `weight`, `align` or `gutterBottom`: use `style` or CSS (`color: 'var(--avl-color-on-background-muted)'` for secondary text).

```tsx
import { Typography } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <>
            <Typography type="h3" as="h1">
                Settings
            </Typography>
            <Typography type="h6" as="h2">
                Notifications
            </Typography>
            <Typography>Choose what you hear about.</Typography>
            <Typography
                type="caption"
                style={{ color: 'var(--avl-color-on-background-muted)' }}
            >
                Updated 2 minutes ago
            </Typography>
        </>
    )
}
```

Sizes (default tokens): h1 57px, h2 45px, h3 36px, h4 32px, h5 28px, h6 24px, body 16px, caption 12px. h1–h3 are display sizes; page titles usually use `h4`–`h6`.

---

<!-- file: docs/avatar.md -->

# Avatar

A picture, initials or icon for a person or thing.

```ts
import { Avatar } from 'anvilui'
import type { AvatarProps } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | | Image URL; the fallback shows while it loads or if it fails. |
| `name` | `string` | | Read by screen readers; its initials are the fallback ("Ada Lovelace" → "AL"). |
| `icon` | `MaterialSymbol` | `'person'` | Fallback without a `name`. |
| `size` | `'small' \| 'normal' \| 'big'` | `'normal'` | 32, 40 or 56px. |
| `color` | `ComponentColor` | `'primary'` | Fallback background. |
| `fillType` | `'filled' \| 'outlined' \| 'text'` | `'filled'` | |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | | Replaces the fallback. |

No `alt` prop: use `name`. Leave `name` out when the name is shown next to it.

```tsx
import { Avatar } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
            <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" src="https://example.com/ada.jpg" />
            <Avatar name="Alan Turing" color="tonal" />
            <Avatar icon="group" size="big" color="container" />
        </div>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/avatar-group.md -->

# AvatarGroup

A row of overlapping `Avatar`s that fans out on hover. Renders a `<div role="group">` and takes `<div>` props; give it an `aria-label`. Set `size` on the group, not on each Avatar.

```ts
import { AvatarGroup, Avatar } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max` | `number` | no limit | Past it, the last spot becomes "+N". |
| `size` | `'small' \| 'normal' \| 'big'` | `'normal'` | Applies to every avatar inside. |
| `fan` | `boolean` | `true` | Spread on hover/focus. |

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from 'anvilui'

const people = [
    'Ada Lovelace',
    'Alan Turing',
    'Grace Hopper',
    'Linus Torvalds',
    'Margaret Hamilton',
]

export function Example() {
    return (
        <AvatarGroup max={4} aria-label="Project members">
            {people.map((name) => (
                <Avatar key={name} name={name} />
            ))}
        </AvatarGroup>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/badge.md -->

# Badge

A dot or count on the corner of what it wraps, or inline on its own. Error-colored by default. Hidden from screen readers.

```ts
import { Badge } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number` | | Omit for a dot; `0` hides it. |
| `max` | `number` | `999` | Above shows "999+". |
| `color` | `ComponentColor` | `'error'` | |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | | What it sits on. |

No `content` / `badgeContent` / `variant`.

```tsx
import { Badge, Icon, IconButton } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <>
            <Badge count={3}>
                <IconButton
                    icon="mail"
                    aria-label="Inbox, 3 unread"
                    fillType="text"
                    color="container"
                />
            </Badge>
            <Badge>
                <Icon name="notifications" />
            </Badge>
            <Badge count={12} color="primary" />
        </>
    )
}
```

Put the count in the wrapped element's `aria-label` too. On a non-interactive icon, label the icon: `<Badge count={4}><Icon name="chat_bubble" aria-label="4 comments" /></Badge>`.

---

<!-- file: docs/progress.md -->

# Progress

A bar or ring showing progress. Needs `label` or `aria-label`.

```ts
import { Progress } from 'anvilui'
import type { ProgressProps } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number \| null` | | `null` = indeterminate (spinning / sweeping). Required by Base UI: pass `null` explicitly for loading. |
| `min` / `max` | `number` | `0` / `100` | |
| `type` | `'linear' \| 'circular' \| 'inline'` | `'linear'` | `inline` is a ring the size of the text. |
| `squiggly` | `boolean` | `false` | Wavy bar (linear only). |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | | Visible label. Either this or `aria-label`. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | | |

There is no `Spinner` / `CircularProgress` / `LinearProgress`: use `<Progress type="circular" value={null} aria-label="Loading" />`. For a loading button, use `<Button loading>`.

```tsx
import { Progress } from 'anvilui'

export function Example({ uploaded }: { uploaded: number }) {
    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 16, width: 300 }}>
            <Progress label="Uploading" value={uploaded} />
            <Progress aria-label="Loading" value={null} squiggly />
            <Progress type="circular" aria-label="Loading" value={null} />
            <span>
                Syncing{' '}
                <Progress type="inline" aria-label="Syncing" value={null} />
            </span>
        </div>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/skeleton.md -->

# Skeleton

A pulsing placeholder while content loads. Hidden from screen readers; put `aria-busy` on the loading region.

```ts
import { Skeleton } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'text' \| 'circular' \| 'rectangular'` | `'text'` | |
| `animation` | `'pulse' \| 'none'` | `'pulse'` | |

Size it with `style` (`width`, `height`). No `width` / `height` props. Renders a `<span>`.

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <div
            aria-busy="true"
            style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center' }}
        >
            <Skeleton variant="circular" style={{ width: 40, height: 40 }} />
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 4, flex: 1 }}>
                <Skeleton style={{ width: '40%' }} />
                <Skeleton style={{ width: '70%' }} />
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
```

---

<!-- file: docs/sticker.md -->

# Sticker

A small tilted label like a die-cut sticker ("NEW", "BETA"). Straightens on hover. Renders a `<span>`.

```ts
import { Sticker } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `ComponentColor` | `'primary'` |
| `startIcon` | `MaterialSymbol` | |
| `tilt` | `number` (degrees) | `-4` |

```tsx
import { Sticker } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <Sticker color="warning" startIcon="bolt">
            NEW
        </Sticker>
    )
}
```

For status labels in tables or lists, a `Chip` or plain text fits better; Sticker is decorative.

---

<!-- file: docs/animated-number.md -->

# AnimatedNumber

A number whose digits roll like an odometer when `value` changes. Renders a `<span>`.

```ts
import { AnimatedNumber } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | Required. |
| `format` | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` | Currency, percent, compact, decimals. |
| `locales` | `Intl.LocalesArgument` | Default: the browser's. |

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { AnimatedNumber, Button } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    const [count, setCount] = useState(1200)
    return (
        <>
            <AnimatedNumber
                value={count}
                format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }}
            />
            <Button onClick={() => setCount(count + 99)}>Add</Button>
        </>
    )
}
```

<!-- file: docs/kbd.md -->

# Kbd

A keyboard key for shortcuts. It presses down while the user holds that key. One `Kbd` per key.

```ts
import { Kbd } from 'anvilui'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | | Key text: `'K'`, `'⌘'`, `'Ctrl'`, `'Esc'`, `'↵'`, … |
| `listen` | `boolean` | `true` | Press down while held. |
| `listenFor` | `string` | from the text | A `KeyboardEvent.key` value. |

```tsx
import { Kbd } from 'anvilui'

export function Example() {
    return (
        <span>
            Press <Kbd>⌘</Kbd> + <Kbd>K</Kbd> to search
        </span>
    )
}
```
